purpose: FinRadar publishes original economic KPIs, benchmarks and automated reports built from public government data. This repo is the website (HTML + JS), the data pipeline that computes the KPIs from public sources, and the automation that updates the numbers daily.
deploy: GitHub Pages: Push this repo to GitHub, then enable Pages at Settings > Pages, Source = main branch (or deploy the static folder). The site is fully static — no server build step.
Cloudflare Pages: Import the GitHub repo, framework 'none', root dir 'FinRadar' (the repo root contains index.html). Static hosting handles the whole site.

structure.index.html: The whole site — hero, live KPI dashboard, benchmarks, KPI glossary, interactive tools, publishable reports, peer rankings, data sources.
structure.styles/main.css: Modern dark theme with glassmorphic cards (teal/violet/orange accents).
structure.scripts/app.js: Client-side renderer: reads data/latest_kpis.json and renders the dashboard, tools and peer table. Interactive: personal inflation calculator + salary parity tool.
structure.data/latest_kpis.json: The computed KPIs + benchmarks — regenerated daily by the pipeline.
structure.scripts/pipeline/fetch_kpis.py: Daily pipeline: fetches public data, computes KPIs, writes data/latest_kpis.json.
structure.data/snapshots/: Fallback data for India-specific figures when sources aren't reachable or when data.gov.in token isn't configured. Labeled 'DEMO SNAPSHOT' in the UI.
structure..github/workflows/daily-update.yml: Scheduled GitHub Action that runs the pipeline daily and commits updates.

World Bank Open Data (verified live, api: NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD — GDP per capita, PPP (current international $)
NY.GDP.MKTP.CD — GDP (current US$), used for headline trends
RBI DBIE / NPCI / MoSPI / data.gov.in: UPI transaction volumes + ticket sizes (digital consumption velocity)
Debt service as share of revenue

kpi_principle: Every number published is a derived metric — a spread (real vs headline, nominal vs PPP), a velocity (UPI ticket), or a composite (Macro Cycle Score). Raw tables are never republished as-is.
data_governance: The pipeline always fetches live data first and falls back to snapshots labeled as such. When a data.gov.in token is present (env var DATA_GOV_IN_TOKEN), live India-specific figures replace the demo fallbacks automatically.

automation.how: GitHub Actions runs `python3 scripts/pipeline/fetch_kpis.py` on a daily schedule, commits data/latest_kpis.json if it changed, and pushes to main.
